scope: Fit eng.1, esp.1, ger.1, ita.1, fra.1 separately. Contrast prior xG-only with prior xG plus deep completions and passes per defensive action from the same Understat team histories. Primary objective is first exact score, followed by ordered-three coverage. Other configured competitions retain their own studies.
features: At each target UTC/source-calendar date read only earlier dates, at most eight domestic games in the previous 150 days per team. Read every game of a date before updating that date's league averages. For each historical side: xG and deep completions scored and allowed relative to its own league's prior home/away venue expectations, and PPDA from the reported att and def counts relative to its venue expectation. League means have 40 pseudo-games at xG 1.35, deep 6.0, PPDA att 220 and def 20. Shrink each team sum/expectation with four corresponding pseudo-games. Positive pressing features mean lower PPDA than the venue norm, as a log ratio. Each feature is clipped to +/-1. An attacking side has six columns: own xG attack, opponent xG concession, own deep attack, opponent deep concession, own pressing, opponent pressing. Missing fields, unmatched teams and stale histories independently supply neutral features, preserving every target.
identity: Use prior Understat names/IDs and the archived league rather than any actual target score to connect sources. Prefer exact unique normalized team names or documented aliases. For other names require a unique historical match-calendar signature on date and home/away side: four or more previous matches within 400 days, at least 75 percent agreement among the latest eight, and at least two more matches than the runner-up. Only earlier dates establish links. Exclude ambiguous identity from model features, not from target denominators. Audit exact target fixture pairs against matching source dates during evaluation; disagreement is separate.
distribution: Within each league fit the same two marginal hurdles for home and away on the chronological R7 anchor. In the first, fit penalized logistic offsets from the anchor's probability of at least one goal to observed scoring/non-scoring. In the second, on positive observed goals fit an exponential tilt on g-1 against the complete anchor marginal conditional on a positive score. Ridge 24 (objective adds 12 times squared L2 norm), coefficient bounds +/-1.5. At inference clip each fitted side shift to +/-0.65. Use iterative row and column rescaling to impose the two predicted marginal distributions on the full R7 joint matrix while preserving score-cell odds ratios. Neutral signals inherit the anchor. Fit separate xG-only and full models on the same calendar.
selection: Use the original R7 training/selection calendars. R10's three-head rule chooses a dose in {0,0.5,1} for each arm on validation alone. First exact, three exact, then exact-score log loss select the score dose. Compare full against R7 and the xG-only arm with its own policy and at the full arm's identical doses. Also retain the two fixed-dose-one forecasts. A zero or unavailable effect inherits the original control selections. R7 original and same-runtime, R10 original, and market compared where measured.
tests: Main dates use original R5/R7/R10 panels with validation in 2024/25, test in 2025/26, and 2026/27 original recent window reported separately. The R11 extension after the original panel (completed 20-23 November) is a separate test on its first nonclosing Bet365 inputs and R7's archived forward recipe where available. If Understat early sources cover the independent R10 2015/16-2018/19 panel, train on 2015/16 and 2016/17, validate on 2017/18, test 2018/19 without sharing future weights. Report coverage, all four KPIs, five-way totals, paired date-cluster intervals per competition and losses and gains for first and three. Compare the predefined tests without post hoc head changes.
forward: For upcoming in-scope R10 first issues with unchanged R5 input prices, refit hurdle slopes on all completed competition targets available through the training cutoff. Freeze the first research selection, two ordered alternatives, independent WDL and Asian totals. Domestic histories are restricted to known dates before issue. Keep existing displayed and R7/R10 forecasts independent. Effective gains require prospective outcomes. No automatic promotion.
